    1. lookup(String)

Interface UserDirectoryProvider

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Extension
public interface UserDirectoryProvider extends Extension
Optional external lookup for missing ECUsers. A directory entry does not grant WebUser access. Implementations must support concurrent calls and bound network waits.
